reader_answers.evidence: The list.item and list.pick forms match ListHelperRow.cs:37-83 and ListReadHelpers.cs:19 and 30-35; count.<key> is at TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:649; the Adjust and Set counter steps are in CounterActions.cs, and the reply step reads their run variables (CounterActions.cs:71,135 and SendMessageAction.cs:97)

The exact-name lookup is PickListService.cs:128; counters change only through the pipeline actions in CounterActions.cs; the Viewer context is excluded at TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22 and TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-40

A missing or empty list gives empty text (ListSource.cs:34,43 and ListText.cs:29-30); a bad form returns null and prints the raw token (ListHelperRow.cs:24,49-54 and HelperNode.cs:17); reading a counter does not change it (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:1094-1111 only loads keys)
